name: Deep Sea Salvage
summary: After Land Ho!, First Mate Nilzlix asks you to recover the charts and logs from two wrecks before anyone leaves the cove.

sections.title: Two Ships Lost in the Reef
sections.body: O'Breen brought three ships into the cove, certain treasure lay there. The Harbinger docked safely. But the Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine reached the reef as the tides began to fall. Both struck a temple-like structure and sank fast.

sections.title: What Nilzlix Wants Back
sections.body: First Mate Nilzlix wants you to recover the logs and charts from both wrecks. He fears the information could reach prying eyes. If enemies found it, Fleet Master Seahorn would force the crew down the plank.

faq.q: Why did the Maiden's Folly and Spirit of Silverpine sink?
faq.answer: The Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine entered the cove as the tides began to fall. Both struck a temple-like structure in the reef and sank quickly.
First Mate Nilzlix speaks of the three ships O'Breen led into the cove. He wants you to recover the logs and charts from the two sunken ships.

faq.q: Why are the charts and logs so important?
faq.answer: Nilzlix fears prying eyes will find the information left behind. If enemies got hold of it, he says Fleet Master Seahorn would force the crew down the plank.

faq.q: What ship made it to safety?
faq.answer: Only the Harbinger docked safely in the cove. The other two ships sank.
Nilzlix names Fleet Master Seahorn as the one who would force the crew down the plank if enemy hands got the records.
